Complete Local Testing Checklist – Handover to Client ​

Use this document to test every flow and edge case on localhost before handing over to the client. Tick each item as you complete it.

Prerequisites (do once) ​

  • [ ] Environment

    • [ ] server/.env has STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_... and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_...
    • [ ] Frontend/.env has VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=pk_test_...
    • [ ] MongoDB running; server and frontend start without errors

  • [ ] Stripe CLI for webhooks

    • [ ] Stripe CLI installed (stripe --version)
    • [ ] Logged in: stripe login
    • [ ] In a separate terminal: stripe listen --forward-to http://localhost:4000/webhooks/stripe
    • [ ] Copy the whsec_... into server/.env as STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, restart server
    • [ ] Keep stripe listen running for the whole test session

  • [ ] Test users

    • [ ] At least one Admin, one Instructor, one Student (with email) that you can log in as

Stripe test cards (reference) ​

ScenarioCard numberExpiryCVC
Success4242 4242 4242 4242Any future (e.g. 12/34)Any 3 digits
3DS required (succeeds after auth)4000 0000 0000 3220Any futureAny 3 digits
Declined (generic)4000 0000 0000 0002Any futureAny 3 digits
Insufficient funds4000 0000 0000 9995Any futureAny 3 digits
Funds available immediately (payout test)4000 0000 0000 0077Any futureAny 3 digits

Use these only in Stripe Checkout / payment forms (test mode). Do not use real cards.

1. Instructor – Stripe Connect & payment readiness ​

1.A – Happy path ​

#TestStepsExpected✓
1.1Start Stripe onboardingAs Instructor, go to Settings → Payment Management. Click “Connect with Stripe” / “Start payment setup”.Redirected to Stripe; complete identity/bank (use test data). Return to app.
1.2Return URL & verifyAfter completing onboarding on Stripe, you are redirected to /payment/complete. Page calls Verify.Status shows “verified” / “Payments enabled” when Stripe has activated the account.
1.3Payment-ready blocks bookingAs Student, find an instructor who has not completed Stripe. Try to book.Error or “Not available for payment” / “Complete Stripe setup”.
1.4Payment-ready allows bookingAs Student, book with an instructor who has completed Stripe.Can proceed to checkout (instant or setup).

1.B – Instructor onboarding edge cases ​

#TestStepsExpected✓
1.5Incomplete onboarding – “Continue setup”As Instructor, start onboarding (get Stripe link) then close the tab without submitting. Go back to Settings → Payment Management.Status “Setup in progress”. Button “Continue setup” (or similar) is shown.
1.6Continue setup opens Stripe againClick “Continue setup”.New Stripe onboarding URL opens; you can complete or add details.
1.7Stripe restricted/rejected – we show itWhen Stripe restricts or rejects the account (e.g. more info needed, verification failed), our app gets this via Verify or webhook account.updated. Instructor goes to Settings → Payment Management.Status shows “Action required” / “Stripe: Action required”. Message like “Stripe needs additional information or has temporarily restricted your account. Resume onboarding to fix this.”
1.8Fix now – open Stripe again after rejectWith status restricted (or disabled), click “Fix now in Stripe” / “Resume onboarding”.A new Stripe onboarding link opens; instructor can fix details and resubmit. (Backend allows a new link when account is not yet verified.)
1.9After return from Stripe (complete page)Complete onboarding on Stripe; land on /payment/complete. Page runs Verify. If status is restricted, page shows “Action required in Stripe” and button “Fix now in Stripe”.Clicking “Fix now in Stripe” opens a new Stripe link so they can fix and try again.
1.10Regenerate link (optional)As Instructor, before finishing onboarding (status “Setup in progress”), use “Continue setup”. Or, if shown, any “Regenerate onboarding link” action.New Stripe onboarding URL works and you can complete from there. (Test 1.6 covers this.)

Note: When Stripe rejects or restricts onboarding, we do show that to the user (restricted/disabled state and message) and we do allow them to try again: “Fix now in Stripe” / “Continue setup” calls the backend to get a new Stripe account link so they can complete or correct onboarding.

2. Student – Instant payment (lesson ≤48h away) ​

#TestStepsExpected✓
2.1Instant checkoutCreate instructor availability for a time within 48 hours from now. As Student, book that slot and go to checkout.Server log: INSTANT (payment now). Redirect to Stripe Checkout with payment (not setup).
2.2Pay with success cardOn Stripe Checkout use 4242 4242 4242 4242. Complete payment.Redirect back with ?checkout=success&session_id=.... Booking confirmed; all slots paid. No T-48 charge for this booking.
2.3Pay with 3DS cardBook again (instant). On Checkout use 4000 0000 0000 3220. Complete 3DS step on Stripe’s page.After 3DS, redirect back; booking confirmed; slots paid.
2.4Declined cardBook again (instant). On Checkout use 4000 0000 0000 0002.Stripe shows error on same page; user can try another card or click Back. If they click Back they hit cancel_url (same as 2.5). Booking stays pending; toast “Payment was cancelled” and link to Book lesson to retry.
2.5Cancel checkoutStart instant checkout; on Stripe page click “Back” or cancel.Redirect to .../booking-details?checkout=cancelled. Toast “Payment was cancelled”; if state was lost (redirect), page shows message + “Go to Book lesson” to retry. Booking stays pending.

3. Student – Deferred payment (lesson >48h away) + T-48 charge ​

#TestStepsExpected✓
3.1Deferred checkout (setup only)Create availability for a time more than 48 hours from now. As Student, book and go to checkout.Server log: DEFERRED (setup mode, charge at T-48). Stripe Checkout in setup mode – no charge, only save card.
3.2Save card and returnComplete Stripe setup (e.g. 4242 4242 4242 4242).Redirect with ?checkout=setup_success&session_id=.... Booking confirmed; slots pending_payment.
3.3T-48 job charges (quick test)Optional: In server/src/jobs/t48ChargeJob.js temporarily set FORTY_EIGHT_HOURS_MS = 2 * 60 * 1000 (2 min). Create a deferred booking for a lesson that starts in >2 min. Wait 2+ min; wait for next T-48 job run (every 5 min by default, or trigger if you have a way).Server log: [T48ChargeJob] Charging slot ... for booking ... then payment succeeded and Done. charged=1. Slot becomes paid. Revert the constant after test.
3.4T-48 with 3DSWith same short window, use a 3DS card (4000 0000 0000 3220) when saving card in setup. When T-48 runs, it will get requires_action.Slot set to requires_action; email “Action required: complete payment”. In Booked lessons, “Complete payment” appears for that slot.
3.5Complete T-48 3DS paymentClick “Complete payment” for a slot in requires_action. Complete 3DS in the flow.Slot moves to paid; booking confirmed when all slots paid.
3.6T-48 declined cardUse 4000 0000 0000 0002 when saving card (setup). When T-48 runs.Slot set to payment_failed (after retries). No charge.
3.7Webhook completes deferred without frontendStart deferred checkout; complete setup on Stripe; close browser before your app’s success page loads.Webhook checkout.session.completed should still save stripeCustomerId and payment method on booking. Next T-48 run can charge (verify with 3.3-style test).

4. Lesson status & payout eligibility ​

#TestStepsExpected✓
4.1Mark lesson completedAs Instructor (or Admin), open the booking and mark a paid slot as Completed.Slot lessonStatus = completed; for paid slots, payoutStatus becomes pending and payoutEligibleAt set (e.g. now + 1 min in your config).
4.2Mark lesson cancelledAs Student or Instructor, cancel one slot of a booking.Slot status cancelled; booking becomes semi_cancelled or cancelled if all cancelled. Availability freed.
4.3Mark lesson missedAs Instructor, mark a slot as Missed (if UI exists).Slot status missed; no refund; availability/booking state consistent.
4.4Payout job runsAfter marking a paid slot completed, wait for payout delay (e.g. 1 min). Wait for payout job (e.g. every 1 min in index.js). Check server log.[PayoutJob] Done. processed=1. Slot payoutStatus = completed; payoutId set. Transaction with type payout and stripePayoutId created.
4.5Refund blocked after payoutIf a slot already has payoutId, request refund for that slot.Refund request rejected or message “instructor already paid out”.

5. Refunds (student request → admin approve/reject) ​

#TestStepsExpected✓
5.1Request refund (valid)Cancel a paid slot first. As Student, request refund for that slot.Refund request created with status pending. Visible in Admin Refund Requests.
5.2Admin approve refundAs Admin, open Refund Requests, approve the request.Stripe: (1) transfer reversal (instructor share), (2) refund to student. Slot paymentStatus = refunded; RefundRequest status approved; transactions: student credit, instructor debit, platform commission reversal.
5.3Admin reject refundAs Student, create another refund request. As Admin, reject it (optional: add reason).RefundRequest status rejected; no Stripe refund/reversal; slot unchanged.
5.4No refund before cancelAs Student, try to request refund for a slot that is not cancelled.Error: “Refund can only be requested for a cancelled lesson”.
5.5No double refundAfter approving a refund, try to request refund again for same slot (or approve again).Error or “already refunded”.

6. Admin – Payment & payout visibility ​

#TestStepsExpected✓
6.1Transactions listAs Admin, open Payments / Transactions (or Admin Transactions page).List of transactions: payments, payouts, refunds, transfer_reversals with amount, type, role, date, Stripe IDs.
6.2Transaction statsOn same page, check summary/cards (total payments, payouts, etc.).Stats match data (or zero if none).
6.3FiltersUse filters (date range, type, role) if available.List updates correctly.
6.4Refund requests listAs Admin, open Refund Requests.Pending / approved / rejected list; can approve or reject.

7. Edge cases & cleanup ​

#TestStepsExpected✓
7.1Abandoned checkout cleanupCreate a pending booking (deferred or instant), go to Stripe Checkout, close tab without completing. Leave booking pending and without stripeCustomerId for >30 minutes. Wait for pending cleanup job (every 30 min).Server log: [PendingBookingCleanupJob] Done: cleaned=1. Booking and slots cancelled; availability freed.
7.2Resume pending bookingCreate pending booking (deferred); leave without completing. Later, as Student, open “Booked lessons” / dashboard and find “Abandoned” or “Continue to checkout” for that booking. Click to resume.Redirect to Stripe again (setup or payment); after completing, booking is confirmed.
7.3Complete payment link (T-48 3DS)For a slot in requires_action, open the “Complete payment” link (from email or dashboard) in a new tab.Page loads with correct booking/slot; after completing 3DS, slot becomes paid.
7.4Instructor without Stripe cannot be paidUse an instructor who has no Stripe account. As Student, try to book.Error or “not available for payment”.
7.5Multiple slots one bookingBook multiple slots in one booking (instant). Pay once.One charge; all slots paid; single PaymentIntent on booking.
7.6Multiple slots one booking (deferred)Book multiple slots in one booking (deferred). After T-48, each slot charged in turn.Each slot gets its own charge when its T-48 time comes; per-slot PaymentIntent; all slots eventually paid.

8. Server logs to watch ​

While testing, keep an eye on the server console:

  • [createBookingCheckoutSession] → DEFERRED vs INSTANT
  • [T48ChargeJob] → Tick, Charging slot..., payment succeeded / requires_action / payment_failed, Done. charged=...
  • [PayoutJob] → Tick, Done. processed=...
  • [PendingBookingCleanupJob] → Done: cleaned=...
  • [Stripe Webhook] → checkout.session.completed, payment_intent.succeeded

9. Quick reference – what to test per flow ​

FlowCards to useWhat to verify
Instant payment4242…, 4000…3220 (3DS), 4000…0002 (decline)Redirect, booking confirmed, slots paid, transactions
Deferred + T-484242… for setup; then T-48 charges 4242… or 3220 (3DS) or 0002 (fail)Setup only; T-48 charges; requires_action + complete payment; payment_failed
RefundAfter cancel slot → request → approveReversal + refund in Stripe; slot refunded; transactions
Payout4000…0077 (immediate availability) or wait; mark completed; wait for jobPayout job creates payout; slot payoutStatus completed; transaction with stripePayoutId

10. Sign-off checklist (before handover) ​

  • [ ] All items in sections 1–7 tested and ticked where applicable
  • [ ] No critical errors in server logs during normal flows
  • [ ] Stripe Dashboard (test mode): payments, Connect account balances, payouts look correct
  • [ ] Env and Stripe keys documented for client (test vs live)
  • [ ] Webhook URL for production documented (Dashboard endpoint + secret)
  • [ ] Any temporary changes (e.g. T-48 window, payout delay) reverted to production-ready values

Optional: production deployment checklist (for client) ​

  • [ ] Replace test Stripe keys with live keys in production env
  • [ ] Create live webhook endpoint in Stripe Dashboard (HTTPS URL)
  • [ ] Subscribe to: checkout.session.completed, payment_intent.succeeded, and Connect events (account.updated, etc.)
  • [ ] Set STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET to the live webhook signing secret
  • [ ] Set payout delay and T-48 interval to production values (e.g. 3 days payout delay, 5–15 min T-48 job)
  • [ ] Run through at least one full flow (booking → payment → complete lesson → payout) in live mode with a real card (small amount) if possible

Document version: 1.0
Use with: Local testing only (test Stripe keys). Do not use real card data in test mode.
